# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.0.6

## Fixed

- **Cloud edition: the whole Today page is the same on every device.** On top of the card layout and weather city from 2.0.5, the photo wall's photos and videos now sync. They are stored privately in your own Cloudflare R2 (same bucket and limits as day photos: up to 50 MB per file, 20 per wall); order, focus point, auto-play and fill/fit travel with your records.
- **Upgrading:** open the cloud edition first in the browser where your photo wall is set up. It uploads those photos once; the Mac app and other devices then show them.
- The weather city is loaded even when the weather card is hidden, so the header chip matches on every device.
- Switching back to the app window refreshes changes made elsewhere.

## Unchanged

- Local edition: photo wall stays in the browser. No database migration; wall files are new objects under your own prefix in R2.

## Roll back

Tag `v2.0.4` stays available (2.0.5 was deployed to the cloud edition only).
